topics.name: ByteDance / TikTok $50B Profit Milestone
topics.summary: ByteDance is on track for ~$50B net profit in 2025, fueled by TikTok, gaming, and aggressive e-commerce expansion, putting it near Meta's scale. The US TikTok sale to Oracle/Silver Lake/MGX is expected to close January 22nd.

topics.name: Meta AI Models: Mango and Avocado
topics.summary: Meta is developing new image and video-focused AI models codenamed Mango and Avocado, expected in H1 2026. Hosts expressed confidence given Meta's data advantages and distribution across 3-4B monthly active users.

topics.name: OpenAI Code Red Declarations
topics.summary: Bloomberg reported OpenAI has declared Code Red multiple times, instructing employees to drop lower-priority tasks. Hosts argued the messaging was a communications problem and suggested 'the great lock-in' as better framing.

topics.name: OpenAI Stargate Government Lobbying
topics.summary: OpenAI sent a letter to the White House urging the federal government to co-invest in Stargate compute for public research, framing 2026 as the year AI unlocks scientific breakthroughs. Hosts noted the tension with OpenAI's own claims of being compute-constrained.

topics.name: OpenAI $100B Fundraise at $830B Valuation
topics.summary: OpenAI is reportedly aiming to raise $100B at an $830B valuation. Hosts joked about the ever-increasing numbers with a reference to 'the number business.'

topics.name: AI Distribution War: App Store Rankings
topics.summary: Analysis of top free app charts showed ChatGPT at #1 but Google holding multiple top-11 spots via Gemini and other apps; Meta also cited as a major distribution player. Hosts discussed whether model quality or distribution will determine AI winners.

topics.name: AI as Business Strategy Tool
topics.summary: Dana White's clip was used to illustrate how AI is being pitched to mainstream entrepreneurs as a strategic advisor. Hosts agreed AI delivers good strategy but execution remains the hard, differentiating factor.

topics.name: Charlemagne the God $200M IHeartMedia Deal
topics.summary: IHeartMedia signed Charlemagne to a 5-year, $200M extension after securing a Netflix deal to stream the Breakfast Club, locking in the key talent.

topics.name: Rubik's Cube Solving Robot
topics.summary: A robot demonstrated solving a Rubik's cube in 0.1 seconds, shown in super slow-motion. Discussed as a remarkable feat of robotics and speed.

topics.name: TBPN 2025 Year in Review
topics.summary: Hosts reflected on 225 live streams, 912 unique guests, 1,219 interviews, and 8,554 X posts in 2025. Highlights included streaming from YC Demo Day, GitHub Universe, and the Figma NYSE IPO.

topics.name: AI Speed vs. Intelligence as Competitive Differentiator
topics.summary: Hosts suggested customers may not perceive differences between 120 vs. 140 IQ chatbots but clearly notice speed differences, proposing 2026 could be the 'year of speed' for AI.

topics.name: TikTok Live-Stream Shopping
topics.summary: TikTok's aggressive push into live-stream shopping was noted as massive internationally but not yet reaching fever pitch in the United States.

key_claims: ByteDance is on track for ~$50B net profit in 2025, with ~$40B earned in the first three quarters alone.

OpenAI has declared Code Red multiple times, not just once, per Bloomberg reporting.

Delian Asperuhov made 18 guest appearances on TBPN in 2025, the most of any guest.
Ryan Peterson was the first-ever guest on TBPN Live.
A robot solved a Rubik's cube in 0.1 seconds.
Charlemagne the God signed a 5-year, $200M deal with IHeartMedia.
OpenAI's letter to the White House frames 2026 as the year AI begins unlocking scientific breakthroughs, as it sped up software development in 2025.
